responsibility: Provides the core target header for GCC’s S/390 backend, defining processor feature flags, target capability macros, machine-function and frame-layout data structures, ABI- and codegen-related target macros, indirect-branch hardening state, and helper expansion macros used by the machine description. It is the central compile-time configuration header that shapes how the rest of the backend interprets options, hardware facilities, stack frames, and instruction variants.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name s390 files, this is the central target header that defines feature macros, machine_function/frame structures, and compile-time backend configuration. Unlike s390.cc it does not implement hooks, unlike s390.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns, and unlike s390.opt it does not declare command-line options.
